title: Every ticket sorted the moment it lands
body: Reply tags each conversation by topic, urgency, and intent before anyone opens it, then routes it to the queue that owns it. Your morning starts with a sorted inbox instead of a pile.
pointOne: Topic, sentiment, and intent on arrival
pointTwo: Ranked by customer impact, not arrival time
pointThree: Routed to the right queue automatically

title: One source of truth, kept honest
body: Every answer cites the document behind it. When a policy changes, Reply flags the answers that relied on the old one so nothing quietly goes stale in the background.
pointTwo: Stale-answer alerts when a doc changes
pointThree: Gap reports for questions your docs can't answer

title: Handovers that don't lose the thread
body: When Reply steps back, your agent gets the conversation summarised, the order and account already open, and a draft reply to accept or rewrite. No scrolling, no re-reading.
pointThree: Confidence thresholds you set per queue

title: Numbers your finance team will believe
body: Resolution rate, cost per ticket, and CSAT split by whether a human touched it. Export it, schedule it, or drop it straight into the weekly review.
pointTwo: CSAT split by human versus Reply
pointThree: Scheduled exports to email or Slack

title: The same answer wherever they ask
body: Email, live chat, WhatsApp, and social all land in one inbox and get the same policy applied. Your customers stop getting three different answers to one question.
pointThree: Full history follows the customer across channels
